display.purpose: Two-tone page and case openers; the closing Say hello field.

headline.purpose: Two-tone chapter and field openers; next-page link.

title.purpose: Plain case story chapter titles; Next project.

figure-impact.purpose: Case result figures on the Impact field.

figure-numbers.purpose: Career figures on the Work field.

figure-tile.purpose: Violet result figures on placeholder work tiles.

body-lead.purpose: First story section, step titles, Impact labels.

label.purpose: Bar links, fact labels, footer, hints.

glows.name: page-opening-glow
glows.value: radial-gradient(closest-side at 50% 50%, rgb(150 118 255 / 0.42), transparent), radial-gradient(closest-side at 72% 58%, rgb(244 196 255 / 0.55), transparent), radial-gradient(closest-side at 28% 62%, rgb(178 196 255 / 0.45), transparent); filter: blur(24px)
glows.purpose: Pinned by the user from a chosen reference: one per page behind the opening statement. Deliberate exception to the radial-spotlight-glow rule. Swells to 1.45x, sinks 160px, fades to 0.15 over the first 650-700px of scroll; static under reduced motion.

glows.name: field-glow
glows.value: radial-gradient(55% 75% at 50% 0%, rgb(124 82 255 / 0.5), transparent), radial-gradient(30% 55% at 84% 0%, rgb(214 120 255 / 0.26), transparent), radial-gradient(28% 50% at 14% 0%, rgb(120 150 255 / 0.2), transparent)
glows.purpose: Light hanging from the top edge inside every Bloom field; drifts from -35% to 0 and 0.4 to 1 opacity as the field enters.

motion.name: bloom-enter
motion.purpose: Field opens from 7% side inset and 36px corners to full bleed; leftovers under 0.07 snap to 0.

motion.name: bloom-leave
motion.purpose: Field stays open while read, closes only as it leaves.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Figures count from 0; screen readers get the final value.

motion.name: section-marker
motion.purpose: Violet underline gliding between case sections.

motion.name: bar-surface
motion.purpose: Header and bars: transparent at the top, solid paper with hairline once scrolled. No blur.

motion.name: hover
motion.value: 300ms colour; 700ms image scale to 1.02; arrow 2px (6px on next-page link, 500ms)

motion.name: lenis
motion.purpose: Root smooth scroll; not mounted under reduced motion.

narrative.overview: Version 2 keeps version 1's white ground, centred columns, Geist at one weight, hairlines and flat tiles, and adds one violet for actions and achieved figures, plus deep aubergine fields that open from an inset rounded panel to full bleed as they scroll into view. Case studies are data-forward: facts row, Impact field, sticky-titled story chapters with numbered step cards, then screens on deep. Motion is scroll-linked, settles once, and stands down under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, violet-tinted ink and greys, one violet, one deep aubergine.
Geist regular everywhere; 500 only for the wordmark and inline bold.
760px reading measure, 960px work measure, fields full bleed.
Bloom fields carry the numbers and the screens.
Oversized tabular figures that count up once.
Flat: no shadows, no blur; one pinned lavender glow per page opening.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only hue. On white it marks actions, progress, current state and achieved figures, never decoration or a region.

rules.name: The Deep Owns Regions Rule
rules.body: Deep aubergine is a whole field or the one filled button; never a card, strip, text colour or border on white.

rules.name: The Soft-Is-Large Rule
rules.body: soft and on-deep-soft only at 24px and up.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Everything 400 except the wordmark and inline bold (500). Figures get size, not weight.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Sentence Rule
rules.body: Pages, site chapters and fields open with one sentence: claim in ink, continuation in soft. Case story chapters open plain.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Depth is ground change and hairline, never shadow or blur.

rules.name: The Pinned Glow Rule
rules.body: The lavender glow appears once per page behind the opening; a user-pinned exception to the radial-glow ban, not a reusable device.

dos: Do alternate white reading columns with deep fields; put numbers and screens in the fields.
Do open fields from inset rounded panel to full bleed and keep them open while read; show them open under reduced motion.
Do set figures large, regular, tabular, label beneath, counting up once with the final value for screen readers.
Do keep violet for actions, progress, current state and achieved figures.
Do keep header and bars transparent at the top and solid paper once scrolled.
Do close every page except /hello on the deep Say hello field.
Do say plainly when screens are not ready and let placeholders carry real figures.
donts: Don't add a second hue, gradient fills or tinted section backgrounds on white.
Don't use soft or on-deep-soft under 24px.
Don't add shadows, backdrop blur, glass or raised cards.
Don't reuse the radial glow beyond the pinned page-opening glow and the in-field glow.
Don't fall back to a stat-card hero, a colourful theme or a hero, card grid, logo strip template.
